timeline.text: Our nightly video factory went dark for two nights — and every log still said 'completed'.
Like a worker still clocking in after they'd gone home, its own memory had ballooned unnoticed.
Now a Python routine resets the agent's memory before every single run, not after some size limit.
One task per clip too, so one failure can't take down the whole night.
And if a night still fails, it gets one retry — catching what the old system missed at 47.5 megabytes.
